provenance.description: HRA / NIH Visible Human female reference subset. Source skin, selected organs and partial skeleton; not exhaustive anatomy, a patient scan or a clinically validated reconstruction. Pregnancy, Allen-brain and Yao reference structures omitted. Source geometry unchanged; subset, materials and highlights are presentation choices.
provenance.copyright: Kristen Browne; Heidi Schlehlein; Human Reference Atlas / HuBMAP. Courtesy of the U.S. National Library of Medicine.
provenance.adaptation: Selected named source subtrees, compacted accessor storage, two-sided display and translucent cyan skin. Skin vertex tint omitted for uniform presentation; all retained positions, normals, colors, indices and coordinate values copied without resampling, decimation or reordering. Group ancestry simplified only where all source transforms are identity.

derived_revision.operation: Append disjoint named source geometry; original geometry/IDs retained; source hierarchy indexed; no field or smoothing
